title: Total Wardrobe Care Eco-Friendly Moth Trap Box. Natural And Non-Toxic, Sticky Glue Board For Common Moths. Anti Moth Repellent Pheromone Trap To Protect Your Clothes And Carpet
bullet_points: COMMON MOTH: The common clothes moth, Tineola bisselliella, is surprisingly small in its adult form at 5 to 8 mm long and are buff or beige colour. The adult female clothes moth emits a pheromone which the male clothes moth can detect via his antennae. It is just the moth larvae that is responsible for holes in wool and fur as they feed on natural material

OUR SOLUTION: Our effective Total Wardrobe Care moth box trap attracts the male moths onto the female pheromone-impregnated adhesive strip, which traps them. It is a completely non-poisonous alternative to chemical clothes moth killer for wardrobe and can be used in your rooms all year round

UNIQUE DESIGN: Our eco friendly moth trap measures 19 x 11 x 2cm, making it much larger in size than other moth traps on the market. The box is also made fully of recyclable cardboard, meaning no more plastic waste! In this pack you will receive 1x Moth box and 1x glue board ready to use

EASY TO USE: Remove the protective film from the glue board and insert it back in the box. Simply place the box somewhere undisturbed, outside the wardrobe – on a shelf, under the bed or under a chest of drawers. The pheromone remains active approximately 10-12 weeks following the removal of the protective bag

ABOUT US: Total Wardrobe Care’s products have been developed to keep the wardrobe beautifully fresh, fragrant, and moth-free. All of Total Wardrobe Care’s products are inspired by nature, and our sachets, candles, oil, sprays and laundry liquid have been specially hand made in the New Forest
